name: TDSQL (Tencent)
tagline: Tencent's financial-grade MySQL-compatible database family: distributed TDSQL and cloud-native TDSQL-C.
description: TDSQL is Tencent's family of relational databases, best known for running core banking at WeBank and other Chinese financial institutions. The distributed editions (TDSQL and the newer TDSQL Boundless) partition data across multi-master nodes with Raft replication, two-phase commit and data-affinity scheduling that keeps related rows on the same node, while staying compatible with MySQL and, for Boundless, the HBase API. TDSQL-C is a separate cloud-native, shared-storage service compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL, similar in spirit to Aurora. It is available on Tencent Cloud and as private-cloud deployments for banks. Outside China its documentation and ecosystem are limited.

pricing.notes: Pay-as-you-go or monthly subscription on Tencent Cloud; TDSQL-C has a serverless billing mode; private-cloud licenses for financial institutions.

scale.notes: Boundless scales from 2 to several hundred nodes with decoupled compute and storage; TDSQL-C scales read nodes on shared storage.

strengths: Proven in Chinese core banking (WeBank) with financial-grade consistency
Multi-master distributed writes with Raft replication
Data-affinity scheduling keeps most transactions single-node
Private-cloud deployment option for regulated institutions
weaknesses: Tencent Cloud-centric; little presence outside China
Product naming and edition boundaries are confusing
English documentation is thinner than Chinese
Closed source with no community edition
useCases: Core banking and payment systems in China
Scaling MySQL workloads on Tencent Cloud
Gaming and social backends in the Tencent ecosystem
Oracle and DB2 replacement in financial services
notIdealFor: Workloads outside Tencent Cloud or China
